design_name: Bear Regime Prediction Engine v1.0 — Dedicated Features (8 academic backbone) + Multi-Source Data (12 sources) + Multi-Model Ensemble (5 models) + Daily-frequency option + Max-history 36yr (1990~2026)
hypothesis_title: 약세 예측 엔진 v1.0 — Dedicated features (학술 backbone) + Qvest infra multi-source + 5-model ensemble + Daily-frequency option + Maximum history (1990~2026, 437 monthly, 36 years, 8 crisis epochs)
hypothesis_description: v5 cycle G1 paradigm-inviable scoped 후 — 약세 예측 자체 fail은 paradigm 한계가 아닌 **실험 설계 부실**에서 비롯됨 (도훈 reframe 정합 + L-330 scope retain). 핵심 변경 6축 (도훈 mandate 2026-05-19 추가): (1) **Dedicated features 32개 신규 구축** — 8 학술 backbone (Estrella-Hardouvelis 1991 yield curve + Stock-Watson 2003 leading indicators + Ang-Chen 2002 asymmetric cor + Engle-Mistry 2014 vol regime + Adrian-Brunnermeier 2016 systemic risk proxy + Gilchrist-Zakrajsek 2012 credit spread + Frazzini-Pedersen 2014 defensive rotation grounding + Hamilton 1989 MSM regime). (2) **Multi-source 12 sources** — Factor DB (monthly 437m + daily) + FRED 22 series + ECOS 7 series + investor_wide foreign flow + SEIBro ETF complex (SEFRS Phase A inherit) + VKOSPI direct fetch path A/B/C + MSM regime engine + M4 BOCPD inherit + macro_regime composite. (3) **5-model ensemble** — Logistic L1 (interpretable baseline) + LightGBM (v5 inherit + interaction) + Random Forest (variance reduction) + LSTM small 5K params (sequential, L-328 over-param 회피) + Markov Switching Hamilton 1989 (state probability). Platt scaling + isotonic calibration. Strategy simple average + stacking compare. (4) **Daily-frequency option** — monthly mode default (437 obs × ~81 pos class) + daily mode auxiliary (~9000 obs × ~1500 pos class, 25× v5). max/mean/streak aggregation compare. (5) **Maximum history 36yr (도훈 mandate 2026-05-19 추가)** — 1990-01 ~ 2026-05 (437 monthly, 3.5× v5 sample, 2.7× positive class). 8 crisis epoch inclusion (1997 IMF + 2000 dotcom + 2008 GFC + 2011 EU + 2015 China + 2018 vol + 2020 COVID + 2022 inflation + 2026-03). Stratum-conditional feature support (S1 universal 3 + S2+ 24 + S4 only 3) + NaN handling explicit + stratum_id feature. (6) **G1 5-subgate strict + AX-008 ≥ 2/3 quorum + Codex Round 6-agent 5-stage**. 병렬 WT_019_001 DPL_KR_v3 alpha와 별도 lifecycle. 도훈 mandate '자율성 발휘' 정합 — 직접 데이터 수집 protocol design + 학술 backbone features 자율 구축 + 임의 backfill 절대 X + imputation 명시.

confidence_vector_explanation: n/a — regime sensor only (NOT cross-sectional alpha sleeve). bear prediction은 market-level time-series probability output (1 value per sig_date, OR per stock if extended to cross-section conditional alpha). 본 cycle scope = time-series first (market-level p_bad). 향후 cross-section conditional alpha 확장 시 confidence_vector 추가 가능.

factor_specs.proxy: 32 dedicated features built on 8 학술 backbone — 1 unified regime sensor family (NOT cross-sectional alpha sleeve)
factor_specs.formula: p_bad_monthly_t = ensemble_calibrate(Logistic_L1(F_t) + LightGBM(F_t) + RandomForest(F_t) + LSTM(F_{t-20:t}) + MarkovSwitching(BM_Ret_{1:t}, F_macro_t)) via Platt scaling on validation set. Default ensemble: simple average (5 models). Strategy compare: stacking + voting. F_t = [F01..F32] dedicated features 8 categories.
factor_specs.lag_rule: t-1 close strict (price/vol/return) + FRED daily T+1 + FRED monthly T+1m+5d + ECOS T+5d + KRX investor T+2 + SEIBro k≥2
factor_specs.feature_count_conditional_VKOSPI: +2 if VKOSPI fetch successful (F15_VKOSPI_level + F16_VKOSPI_zscore_252d, S3+ 2003~)
factor_specs.method_shopping_note: 단일 unified design family — 8 학술 backbone single coherent paper-driven catalog. method_shopping_log.candidates_tried = 1. 32 features는 sub-component이지 별도 method 아님. SEFRS Phase A precedent inherit (12 sub-features = 1 family).
factor_specs.economic_rationale: 8 학술 backbone academic prior-driven bear regime sensor. v5 fail mode '80 general alpha features (defensive 55%, FMP r² ranking)' → v1 'dedicated 32 features 100% 학술 backbone, no ranking, no shopping'. 약세 예측은 time-series classification (not cross-sectional ranking) — v5 paradigm-level scope 정합 + L-330 retain. Charter §15 Research Philosophy P1 (Factor Zoo 축소 Validation > Discovery) + P3 (Uncertainty-aware Forecasting) + P5 (Risk Model 고도화) 정합.

diagnostics.rank_ic_note: n/a — bear prediction is time-series classification (not cross-sectional). Equivalent metrics: AUC, Brier score, Recall, Precision.
diagnostics.icir_note: n/a — same reason. AUC ≥ 0.60 (G1 subgate 1) as equivalent stability metric.
diagnostics.harvey_t_count_note: Phase A marker. Forge cycle Stage 3 NW-adjusted t-stat for ensemble p_bad_monthly vs forward 1M BM_Ret (Diebold-Mariano test against persistence baseline + random baseline). Target ≥ 3 specs with NW t > 2.95 (Codex C5 STRENGTHENED).
diagnostics.monotonicity_note: Forge Stage 2/3 decile event study + bear-state vs bull-state forward 1M BM_Ret monotonicity test. selection_objective = monotonicity (R4 P3 정합).
diagnostics.subperiod_stability_target: 4/5 sub-windows pass G1 5-subgate (v5 0/4 fail target fix)
diagnostics.auc_target: G1 subgate 1: AUC ≥ 0.60 per sub-window (v5 0.6504 marginal pass → tighten + extend to 4/5 windows)
diagnostics.brier_target: G1 subgate 2: Brier < 0.20 per sub-window (v5 0.2984 → tighter)
diagnostics.recall_target: G1 subgate 3: Recall ≥ 0.60 per sub-window (v5 0.089 catastrophic → 7× improvement target)
diagnostics.precision_target: G1 subgate 4: Precision ≥ 0.40 per sub-window (v5 0.0769~0.1538 → 3× improvement target)
diagnostics.g3_feature_stability_target: Gini concentration < 0.5 AND top-10 Jaccard overlap ≥ 0.6 across 5 sub-windows
diagnostics.g4_dsr_target: N/A for standalone regime sensor (Path B). If Path A DPL_KR_v3 integration, downstream NAV DSR Bailey-LdP Z ≥ 1.5

selection_objective_rationale: role_objective_guard enum compliance (rank_ic / icir / monotonicity / subperiod_stability). monotonicity 선택 사유: bear-state probability vs forward BM_Ret monotonicity test (high p_bad → low forward return)가 G1 admission의 핵심 criterion. Phase A design phase는 design protocol coherence 평가만, actual selection은 Forge cycle 후 결정. 부수 metric: G1 sub-window AUC + Recall + Precision + sub-window 4/5 stability + G3 feature importance stability.

challenge_flags.concern: S1 (1990~2000, 132 monthly) period에는 macro features (yield curve / VIX / credit spread / foreign flow) 전부 missing. 단 3 features universal (F14 KOSPI realized vol + F31 defensive vs cyclical + F32 defensive rotation z-score)만 active. Tree ensemble (LightGBM NaN native) + stratum_id one-hot handles, but LSTM/MSM cannot handle NaN natively — S2+ subset (305 monthly, 2001~) only.
challenge_flags.resolution_path: (a) Forge cycle empirical compare 3 strategies — Strategy A full-history with feature mask (LightGBM primary), Strategy B 2001+ start stable features all 5 models, Strategy C 2003+ start with VKOSPI. (b) historical_coverage_audit.md S1~S4 stratum table + imputation explicit documentation 도훈 mandate 정합. (c) NaN handling: LightGBM native + stratum_id indicator + per-stratum median impute for RF.
challenge_flags.academic_grounding: Lopez de Prado 2018 AFML Ch 5 (feature engineering with structural breaks). Pre-1997 KR market structurally different (pre-IMF emerging market) — stratum-aware modeling academically standard.

challenge_flags.concern: VKOSPI (F15/F16) 직접 수집 mandate (Path A: KRX API / Path B: pykrx / Path C: manual). Forge cycle Stage 1 fetch 실패 시 F15/F16 omit. Vol regime feature F14 (KOSPI realized vol KR-side) + F11~F13 (VIX FRED) proxy retain로 partial cover, 단 KR-specific VKOSPI는 우월한 signal 가능성.
challenge_flags.resolution_path: Forge cycle 시 Path B (pykrx Python) primary attempt. 실패 시 Path A (KRX 정보데이터시스템 API). 모두 실패 시 manual CSV download. Final fallback: F15/F16 omit, 32 → 30 features.
challenge_flags.academic_grounding: Whaley (2009) JPM 'Understanding the VIX' — VKOSPI KR equivalent strong forward bear indicator. Forge cycle pre-fetch attempt mandatory.

challenge_flags.concern: Daily-frequency mode (axis 4) provides 25× sample expansion but ~6× computational cost (~96 min Forge cycle vs ~16 min monthly). Spec forecast_horizon = 1M ⇒ monthly mode forecast-aligned. Daily mode = auxiliary only.
challenge_flags.resolution_path: Monthly mode default. Daily mode as Forge cycle compare option only if G1 5-subgate monthly fails or marginal pass. Decision criterion: daily admit only if G1 pass count > monthly at same params.
challenge_flags.academic_grounding: Lopez de Prado 2018 AFML Ch 7 (sample size for ML — 25× expansion not always uplift due to non-stationarity).

challenge_flags.concern: 8 crisis epochs (1997 IMF / 2000 dotcom / 2008 GFC / 2011 EU / 2015 CN / 2018 vol / 2020 COVID / 2022 inflation) each distinct mechanism. Model trained on full set may underfit specific crisis patterns OR overfit to early KR market (S1) regime that differs from 2020s mature market.
challenge_flags.resolution_path: (a) crisis_sample_inclusion.md stress set A (8 crisis stratification) pre-declared. (b) per-crisis Recall + Precision per-window evaluation. (c) Forge cycle alternative crisis-stratified 5-fold optional compare. (d) feature normalization rolling-z 60m for macro/flow (cross-stratum stationary).
challenge_flags.academic_grounding: Stock-Watson 2003 — leading indicators 학술적 stable across crises. Estrella-Hardouvelis 1991 — yield curve inversion robust across 1957~2000 multiple recessions. Academic backbone designed exactly for cross-crisis generalization.

challenge_flags.concern: L-328 DPL_KR_v1 165K params over-parameterized fail. 본 cycle LSTM = 5K params (hidden=32, n_layers=2). Monthly mode (437 obs) 시 437/5000 = 0.09 obs/param ratio = 어렵음. Daily mode (9000 obs) 시 9000/5000 = 1.8 obs/param ratio = OK.
challenge_flags.resolution_path: Monthly mode: LSTM may be solo-fragile, role = ensemble member only (4 other models compensate). Daily mode: LSTM stronger. Forge cycle LSTM individual Recall/Precision report — if catastrophic (Recall < 0.3 across 5 windows), drop from ensemble.
challenge_flags.academic_grounding: Lu-Yang-Zhang (2024) arXiv:2411.18830 double-descent — over-parameterized NN can generalize under specific regime. 본 cycle small 5K = below DD threshold. Forge cycle empirical decision.

selection_objective_phase_a_supplementar: Phase A scope에서 selection은 design protocol coherence + PIT rigor + feature catalog completeness + multi-source protocol + ensemble design rationale 평가만. Codex Round Stage 4~5 evaluation 정합. G9 Codex pass = phase_a_design_only_evaluation. Alpha admission cert 발급은 Forge cycle Stage 4 후 별도 Codex Round.
